sh_hook: Move a graph up, down and sideways.
sh_stage_aria: Graph of f and its shift: {title}
sh_step_intro_caption: This is f. Watch its peak, its valley and where it crosses zero.
sh_step_vertical_caption: Adding d lifts every point by d. Drag the graph.
sh_step_opposite_caption: Now the 2 goes inside the brackets: f(x + 2).
sh_step_opposite_predict_caption: Which way does f(x + 2) move? Drag the marker to where the peak lands.
sh_step_opposite_answer_caption: Left! The graph moves the opposite way to the sign.
sh_step_lookup_caption: To get g at x, f is read at x + 2. Every height arrives 2 units early.
sh_step_horizontal_caption: f(x − c) moves right by c, a negative c moves it left. Drag sideways.
sh_step_both_caption: f(x − c) + d: move the graph anywhere.
